title: Updates to Device Control and Data Access, and Full Disk Access in macOS
description: For decades, Mac computers have been loved by creators and developers who build, automate, and innovate using cutting-edge technologies and tools. We want to keep empowering our community in these pursuits, while helping our users stay safe and in control of their data and privacy. In macOS 27.3 beta 2 today, we’re introducing increased transparency and more granular options for two of the APIs: Device Control and Data Access, and Full Disk Access. Before granting an app such extraordinary access, users should understand that it puts all of the data on their Mac at risk. These changes are designed to help them do that and to empower them to make informed decisions about their own data and privacy. summary_ja: macOS 27.3 beta 2では、Device Control and Data AccessおよびFull Disk Accessについて、ユーザーがデータ保護をより細かく管理できるよう透明性を強化しました。Device Control and Data Accessが2つの設定に分割され、ユーザーが個別に許可を制御できるようになります。開発者は、アプリがこれらの権限をリクエストする際に、ユーザーへの説明をより明確にする必要があります。
